identity.kind: automatic plastic bottle making machine (PET bottle)

claims.claim: Automatic Plastic Bottle Making Machine used in production to make pet plastic bottles of different...
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a plastic bottle making machine, but PET and bottle-size range are not readable/confirmed.
Seller says they tested it yesterday, but there is no running video, control-screen status, or output shown.
No service invoice/receipt or readable service sticker is provided; photo 0 does not show documentation.
No parts/tooling inventory or photos of included molds/tooling are provided.
No readable serial/nameplate in photo 0 to verify originality.

risks.risk: Exact model/spec (capacity, bottle size range, power/voltage) is unknown, which drives the price.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the machine nameplate/serial plate and control panel model/spec label (readable text).
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst-case for an unknown-spec automatic PET bottle machine (no premium for claimed capacity/variety).

risks.risk: Working condition cannot be verified remotely; seller’s claim is not proof without output.
risks.proof: Short video of full start-up and a production run showing no alarms and bottles being produced.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (assume buyer may need repairs/calibration).

risks.risk: Tooling/mold set completeness is unknown; missing molds can make the machine unusable for intended bottle sizes.
risks.proof: Photos of all molds/tooling included with a count; show which mold is installed and any spare sets.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as uncertain tooling included (assume buyer may need to source molds).

risks.risk: Service history/authenticity cannot be confirmed without documents and serial match.
risks.proof: Service invoice/receipt and a serial number/nameplate photo that matches the paperwork.

risks.risk: Hidden wear/damage (heater elements, gearbox/belts, sensors) not visible in a single wide shot.
risks.proof: Close-ups of heater/extruder/necking area, gearbox/belts, sensors, and any error logs on the HMI.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at average-wear/unknown condition (no premium for 'recently serviced').

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the machine nameplate/serial plate (brand, model, year, voltage/power).
Send a short video of the machine running: start-up → no alarms → producing bottles (show output).
Send photos of all included molds/tooling (count + close-ups) and show the installed mold.
Send the dealer service invoice/receipt (or service sticker) and a serial number that matches the machine.
Send close-ups of key wear parts (heater/extruder area, gearbox/belts, sensors) and the control screen status.
response.reason: The seller’s statement that they tested it is not verifiable without a running video/output and the exact model/spec is still unreadable from photo 0. Without those, a reliable worst-case Abuja price cannot be set.
